title: CIA-UAP-006, Sighting Of Unconventional Aircraft
what_is_it: A CIA information report documenting an eyewitness sighting of unconventional triangular aircraft near Baku, Azerbaijan in 1955.
interpretation_warnings: The source is an image (JPG) and OCR extraction failed almost entirely — the extracted text is garbled and nearly unreadable.
Almost all key facts are derived from the CSV metadata description provided by war.gov rather than directly from the document body text.
Heavy redaction is evident; the document has previously only been available in redacted form on CIA's public site.
Single-source eyewitness account from one US national; no corroborating observations noted.
The sighting occurred near a Soviet-era airfield during the Cold War; the aircraft may have been experimental Soviet craft rather than anomalous objects.
No verbatim source quotes could be reliably extracted due to the severity of OCR failure on this image document.
